V0__rows__random5.note: diagnostic only; no fold_isolation_check level (pre-registration section 2 lists V1-V6); the partition of MODEL rows per seed is asserted

value_blind_check_report.note: REPORTED ONLY (section 2 sensitivity): near-duplicate condition keys shared across the boundary at any log D value; the registered guard (tol 0.005) passed on every fold

V1__copy__grouped10.assignment: seeded greedy balance: groups in a SeedSequence([seed, 1]) random order, each to the fold with the fewest MODEL rows so far

V2__state__exact.hiding: state (the state + the element's X(?)); other known states stay in training

V5PAIR__primary__batched.rule: heavy-arm V5-PAIR folds (section 3.1 resolution 2026-09-15), seed 104729 only, batches inside each half: units = the unbatched cell-pair folds of V5PAIR__primary__cell_pair; two units conflict when they share a metal state or a system; greedy colouring with vertex order SeedSequence([104729, 7, half]); every cell of a unit is re-checked eligible (k10 p1 m3, non-bridge) on MODEL rows minus the registered hiding of every other cell of the batch (its pair partner included); a failing unit moves to a singleton batch; test-test comparable pairs are regenerated from the batch's hidden-scored rows and equal the union of its units' pairs (V5PAIR__primary__batched__pairs.parquet, column unit_fold_id); guard V5 component-aware plus pair_isolation_check

counts.definition: unordered pairs of primary-eligible cells under one system with >= 3 comparable row pairs (same group_cross_publication_copy, same system, identical condition_key, different metal state) among scored rows; both cells hidden (registered component-aware rule); each cell re-checked eligible with the other hidden; pairs touching V6_TARGET_ROWS excluded

V5P__base__batched.rule: heavy-arm V5-P folds (section 3.1 resolution 2026-09-15), seed 104729 only, batches inside each half: units = the unbatched cell x publication-group folds of V5P__base__cell_x_group; two units conflict when they share a metal state, a system or a publication group; greedy colouring with vertex order SeedSequence([104729, 6, half]); a unit is re-checked with every other unit of its batch hidden: (a) the V5-P base eligibility of its cell (k10 p2 m3, non-bridge) on MODEL rows minus the other units' hidden rows (the literal 'every eligibility condition': k and p count the cell's rows left after the other units' publication groups are removed) and (b) the masking rule (>= 3 other metal states for the system, >= 3 other systems for the metal) on MODEL rows minus every unit's hidden rows; a unit failing either moves to a singleton batch (its unbatched fold); a batch hides the union and scores the union of its units' rows; guard V5 component-aware on every row of the batch's cells plus V1 on its scored rows

counts.rule: every group-masked training set keeps >= 3 other metal states for the system and >= 3 other systems for the metal

V5__cell_only__batched.rule: greedy colouring of the conflict graph (shared metal state or system) within each half, vertex order SeedSequence([seed, 5, half]); each cell re-checked eligible with the batch's other cells hidden, failures to singleton batches; carved-out cells are not batched

V5__hno3_only__batched.rule: greedy colouring of the conflict graph (shared metal state or system) within each half, vertex order SeedSequence([seed, 5, half]); each cell re-checked eligible with the batch's other cells hidden, failures to singleton batches; carved-out cells are not batched

V5__loose__batched.rule: greedy colouring of the conflict graph (shared metal state or system) within each half, vertex order SeedSequence([seed, 5, half]); each cell re-checked eligible with the batch's other cells hidden, failures to singleton batches; carved-out cells are not batched

V5__parent_structure__batched.rule: greedy colouring of the conflict graph (shared metal state or system) within each half, vertex order SeedSequence([seed, 5, half]); each cell re-checked eligible with the batch's other cells hidden, failures to singleton batches; carved-out cells are not batched

V5__primary__batched.rule: greedy colouring of the conflict graph (shared metal state or system) within each half, vertex order SeedSequence([seed, 5, half]); each cell re-checked eligible with the batch's other cells hidden, failures to singleton batches; carved-out cells are not batched

V5__strict__batched.rule: greedy colouring of the conflict graph (shared metal state or system) within each half, vertex order SeedSequence([seed, 5, half]); each cell re-checked eligible with the batch's other cells hidden, failures to singleton batches; carved-out cells are not batched

hash_rules.assignment_sha256: sha256 of the LF CSV 'row_id,fold_id,role,unit,half' sorted by row_id, fold_id

leakage_sensitivity_wildcard_copies.rule: leakage sensitivity (verification finding VL-04), REPORTED, not a registered guard: leakage.wildcard_copy_pairs on MODEL rows (near-duplicate key sig 6 with the oxidation state wildcarded and a different state label, or without the structure key and a different system; |delta log D| <= 0.005); strict_copy = every state-wildcard pair plus structure-wildcard pairs with a bit-identical, non-decade D_raw; a crossing = a scored row whose partner stays in the fold's training rows

V1__copy__grouped10.note: vacuous under current code: this design's inner splitter sets no certificate, so ConformalWrapper checks every inner split directly in nested_certificate mode and the two modes are identical by construction; the draw is kept in case a splitter of this design gains a certificate
V1__copy__grouped10.population: the ten grouped V1 outer folds of seed 104729

V2__element__exact.note: vacuous under current code: this design's inner splitter sets no certificate, so ConformalWrapper checks every inner split directly in nested_certificate mode and the two modes are identical by construction; the draw is kept in case a splitter of this design gains a certificate
V2__element__exact.population: the V2 selection-half metal states (registered element-level hiding)

V5PAIR__primary__batched.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row)
V5PAIR__primary__batched.population: V5-PAIR heavy-arm batches of seed 104729 in the selection half (section 3.1 resolution)

V5PAIR__primary__cell_pair.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row)
V5PAIR__primary__cell_pair.population: V5-PAIR unbatched cell-pair folds of the selection half (closed-form arms, B6 / B6r0 included)

V5P__base__batched.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row)
V5P__base__batched.population: V5-P heavy-arm batches of seed 104729 in the selection half (section 3.1 resolution)

V5P__base__cell_x_group.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row)
V5P__base__cell_x_group.population: V5-P unbatched cell x publication-group folds of the selection half (closed-form arms, B6 / B6r0 included)

V5__cell_only__batched.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row), component_aware=False
V5__cell_only__batched.population: V5 cell-only refit-sensitivity batches of seed 104729 in the selection half (certificate without component-aware hiding)

V5__parent_structure__batched.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row), component_map=registered.parent_component_map()
V5__parent_structure__batched.population: V5 parent-structure refit-sensitivity batches of seed 104729 in the selection half (certificate through the parent-structure component map)

V5__primary__batched.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row)
V5__primary__batched.population: V5-primary heavy-arm batches of seed 104729 in the selection half

V5__primary__exact.inner_splitter: InnerCellCalibration (V5 inner design; certificate = the inner cell's registered hiding on every MODEL row)
V5__primary__exact.population: V5-primary exact leave-one-cell-out folds of the selection half with a scored row (B6 / B6r0 inner tuning; the deterministic arms' multi-seed conformal calibration)

nested_certificate_safeguard_sample.rule: pre-registration section 2 (resolution 2026-09-15): every_split is also run at discovery start on 20 outer folds per design drawn with numpy.random.default_rng(19), stratified by metal category (Ln / An / other) where the design has cells; a difference in residuals, quantiles or guard verdicts makes every_split mandatory for that design. Draw rule: gen19ct.folds.safeguard (module docstring); the comparison itself runs at discovery start
nested_certificate_safeguard_sample.which_designs: every outer fold file discovery fits with an arm whose inner splits carry a certificate (the V5 inner design, InnerCellCalibration): V5-primary exact and seed-104729 batches, the cell-only and parent-structure batches (their certificate construction differs), V5-P and V5-PAIR unbatched and seed-104729 batched folds; selection half. The V1 and V2 draws are kept and labelled vacuous (their splitters set no certificate). Task X, findings VR-03 / VR-04

V5PAIR_eligible_cell_pairs.definition: unordered pairs of primary-eligible cells under one system with >= 3 comparable row pairs (same group_cross_publication_copy, same system, identical condition_key, different metal state) among scored rows; both cells hidden (registered component-aware rule); each cell re-checked eligible with the other hidden; pairs touching V6_TARGET_ROWS excluded

V5P_eligible_after_masking.rule: every group-masked training set keeps >= 3 other metal states for the system and >= 3 other systems for the metal

readings.guard_test_sets: V1: every hidden row; V2: the target state's rows; V5 / V5-PAIR / V5-P: every row of the fold's cells (all media); V5-P also level V1 on its scored (cell x group) rows
readings.inner_v1: greedy balance of the publication groups' outer-training row counts over 3 inner folds (SeedSequence([seed, 11])) -- source_holdout.inner_group_assignment, also used by models.interface.GroupKFoldCalibration (the V1 and V0 calibration design)
readings.inner_v2: 3 of the V2-eligible states of the outer training rows drawn by SeedSequence([seed, 12]) -- metal_holdout.inner_state_pick, also used by models.interface.InnerMetalCalibration
readings.inner_v5: eligibility recomputed on the outer training rows; cells with a V6_TARGET_ROWS row or no scorable row are excluded; majority group ties to the smallest group id; groups assigned to the 3 inner folds by the seeded greedy balance of cell counts (SeedSequence([seed, 15])); subsample of 30 per inner fold (SeedSequence([seed, 16, k])) -- cell_holdout.inner_cell_majority + inner_cell_assignment, the one implementation also used by models.interface.InnerCellCalibration
readings.nested_certificate_safeguard: section 2 resolution 2026-09-15: gen19ct.folds.safeguard.registered_safeguard_samples; a sample of 20 (stratified by metal category) for every outer fold file discovery fits with an arm whose inner splits carry a certificate -- only the V5 inner design (InnerCellCalibration) builds one: V5-primary exact folds with a scored row and seed-104729 batches, V5 cell-only and parent-structure seed-104729 batches (their certificate construction differs from the primary's), V5-P and V5-PAIR unbatched folds and seed-104729 batches; selection half. The ten V1 grouped folds of seed 104729 and the V2 selection-half states keep their draw, labelled vacuous under current code (GroupKFoldCalibration and InnerMetalCalibration set no certificate). A population of <= 20 folds is taken whole. Revised by task X (findings VR-03 / VR-04): the first draw covered V5-primary batches, V1 and V2 only
readings.scored_rows: hidden rows with a known metal state, not Sr(III), not V6_TARGET_ROWS, in every design (X(?) rows are never scored, V0 and V1 included)
readings.support_tau: section 13 thresholds per fold on MODEL rows minus the fold's hidden rows (evaluation.support.fold_tau: 50th / 95th / 99.5th percentile of the leave-one-row-out condition_distance_pair over training rows whose (state, system) pair has >= 2 training rows); written beside fold_hash, not part of it
readings.v0_guard: no fold_isolation_check level (section 2 lists V1-V6); the per-seed partition is asserted
readings.v1_grouped10: all group_cross_publication_copy groups whole; seeded random order (SeedSequence([seed, 1])), each group to the fold with the fewest MODEL rows so far
readings.v1_near_duplicate_key: checked value-blind (near_dup_value_tol=None), section 3.2; compilation_doi at tol 0.005
readings.v5_batched: batches are formed inside each half; carved-out cells (any row in V6_TARGET_ROWS) are not batched; the re-check applies the single-cell eligibility rule to MODEL rows minus the registered hiding of the batch's OTHER cells; failing cells move to singleton batches
readings.v5_hno3_only: eligibility on HNO3 rows alone (feasibility grid); the cell is hidden whole whatever the medium (section 3.1 'cells are hidden whole'); its HNO3 rows are scored
readings.v5p: base = scored cells at k10 p2 m3 (p on g19_publication_id); publication group = group_cross_publication_copy; a cell stays eligible only if EVERY one of its group-masked training sets keeps >= 3 other metal states for the system and >= 3 other systems for the metal (the count with any passing group is reported as the lenient reading)
readings.v5p_batched: heavy-arm V5-P folds (section 3.1 resolution 2026-09-15), seed 104729 only, batches inside each half: units = the unbatched cell x publication-group folds of V5P__base__cell_x_group; two units conflict when they share a metal state, a system or a publication group; greedy colouring with vertex order SeedSequence([104729, 6, half]); a unit is re-checked with every other unit of its batch hidden: (a) the V5-P base eligibility of its cell (k10 p2 m3, non-bridge) on MODEL rows minus the other units' hidden rows (the literal 'every eligibility condition': k and p count the cell's rows left after the other units' publication groups are removed) and (b) the masking rule (>= 3 other metal states for the system, >= 3 other systems for the metal) on MODEL rows minus every unit's hidden rows; a unit failing either moves to a singleton batch (its unbatched fold); a batch hides the union and scores the union of its units' rows; guard V5 component-aware on every row of the batch's cells plus V1 on its scored rows
readings.v5pair: comparable pairs on the group_cross_publication_copy basis (section 2 'same publication group'; the g19_publication_id count is reported beside it), counted among the scored rows of the two cells; a cell pair 'touches' V6_TARGET_ROWS when any row of either cell is in it; each cell is re-checked with the other cell's registered hiding applied; test-test pairs are generated from the fold's hidden-scored rows only
readings.v5pair_batched: heavy-arm V5-PAIR folds (section 3.1 resolution 2026-09-15), seed 104729 only, batches inside each half: units = the unbatched cell-pair folds of V5PAIR__primary__cell_pair; two units conflict when they share a metal state or a system; greedy colouring with vertex order SeedSequence([104729, 7, half]); every cell of a unit is re-checked eligible (k10 p1 m3, non-bridge) on MODEL rows minus the registered hiding of every other cell of the batch (its pair partner included); a failing unit moves to a singleton batch; test-test comparable pairs are regenerated from the batch's hidden-scored rows and equal the union of its units' pairs (V5PAIR__primary__batched__pairs.parquet, column unit_fold_id); guard V5 component-aware plus pair_isolation_check
readings.v6_rows_in_a_hidden_unit: V6_TARGET_ROWS inside a held-out unit (V0 fold, V1 group, V2 element, hiding scope of a cell) are hidden with it and not scored; they stay in training everywhere else. The same holds inside inner folds, so every inner split passes its design guard
readings.wildcard_copies: leakage sensitivity (verification finding VL-04), REPORTED, not a registered guard: leakage.wildcard_copy_pairs on MODEL rows (near-duplicate key sig 6 with the oxidation state wildcarded and a different state label, or without the structure key and a different system; |delta log D| <= 0.005); strict_copy = every state-wildcard pair plus structure-wildcard pairs with a bit-identical, non-decade D_raw; a crossing = a scored row whose partner stays in the fold's training rows
